set.name: graphify_core
set.description: Upstream Graphify at commit 20a20d30 (the RepoAtlas-independent checkout): the whole graphify/ package (~225 files, ~49k lines of Python in the top-level modules plus extractors, skills and docs) and two of its test modules. 9 questions: where x2, flow x2, config x2, why, impact, tests.
set.gold_verified_by: Gold facts were written by reading the upstream source at commit 20a20d30d8e7eef77675651f0199d87f913bd3e7 (graphify/serve.py, cli.py, querylog.py, cache.py, security.py, watch.py, benchmark.py, tests/test_security.py); each fact's source.at/source.contains pair is re-checked against the benchmark copy before scoring (metrics.validate_gold).

provenance.questions_written_by: benchmark harness author (an agent, round 1), before any approach was run on the set
provenance.gold_written_by: same author, by reading the upstream source at 20a20d30
provenance.caveat: the round-3 retrieval design was made after seeing RepoAtlas's misses on this set (docs/DESIGN.md 3.1), so RepoAtlas results on it are in-sample; questions and gold have not changed since 05890a1

repoatlas_analyze.budget: config defaults (60 s, 40 tool calls, 6000 tokens)

sweep.rule: context cap = 4 x tokens characters for every approach; Graphify is given ceil(4 x tokens / 3) of its own 3-chars-per-token budget, raw char_cap = 4 x tokens, retrieve_text Budget(10, 4 x tokens) rendered at 4 x tokens chars

llm.status: not measured: llm='none' (use --llm anthropic with ANTHROPIC_API_KEY set)

raw.note: no index; every query greps and reads the working tree

repoatlas.what: workflow.scan = Graphify-derived AST index (in-process) + snapshot (file hashes) + stale-claim check; warm = same tree again with the AST cache present
